scope: Full text of the general completion panel and its view model, considered for explicit synthetic preview reuse. Not imported-source or visual acceptance.

entries.observation: Pure React rendering of supplied completion metadata. No embedded private host, owner or project records; no network calls, raw artifact reader, buttons, or command capability. Supports empty, pending, changes-requested and superseded states. Existing CSS classes are in the shared stylesheet. Does not itself label simulation provenance or provide interactive review/revision. Alias type import needs candidate compiler support. Existing static-markup tests do not prove full browser accessibility or integration.

Generic schema-validated metadata projection with separate quality/operation approval language. No private identity constants, raw artifact bytes or fetching. Caller supplies already-redacted review facts; this is not a store reader or an authorization boundary. Does not calculate quality independently from evidence. Reuse without passing fixture states off as current database facts; retain grantsApproval=false and grantsExecutionAuthority=false.
